scientific_integrity: The conclusion rests on a complete acyclic discrete Morse matching, exact integer attaching-degree verification, and Hurewicz; mod-two homology alone is not treated as a proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed Pappus graph at parameter two. No equivariant or all-family theorem. Unindexed equivalence and independent verification remain possible.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy of the Pappus graph two-independence complex
